verdict.rationale: Auth0's first-party Token Vault is documented as obtaining, storing, and refreshing access and refresh tokens so AI agents can call third-party APIs (Google, Slack, GitHub, Gmail, Spotify; 30+ integrations) without handling credentials directly. This sits within Auth0's broader agent offering of delegated authorization on the user's behalf. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the token-exchange mechanics, of short-lived token lifetimes, and of the user-consent step for connecting accounts; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
